item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Mindset. Your day's already stacked with the mental reps — a morning reset, a check-in with your own perspective, a gut-check on whether a moment fits the life you want, and a later pause to ask if you're mind-reading instead of checking facts. That's the whole game today: catch the story you're telling yourself before you act on it. Action: before you react to anything today, pause and ask what's assumption versus what's actually true.
